title.narrative: Transition project for the fight against malaria - Chad (01-Jul-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Chad, Malaria, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Chad)This program has the following goals: D’ici juin 2021, réduire de 30% la morbidité liée au paludisme par rapport à son niveau de 2016. D’ici juin 2021, réduire de 30% la mortalité liée au paludisme par rapport à son niveau de 2016. D’ici juin 2021, mener à terme 85% des interventions de soutien à la lutte contre le paludisme . The objectives of this program are: 80% of the general population and in particular pregnant women and children under the age of five sleep under a LLIN. 80% of the pregnant women accessing antenatal care (ANC) are provided with a minimum package of interventions including intermittent preventive treatment (IPT) with sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine (SP) in line with the national guidelines on reproductive health. 80% of children under 5 years of age benefit annually from seasonal malaria chemoprophylaxis (SMC) in the relevant health districts. 95% of suspected malaria cases at the level of the health facilities and at the community-level have access to a quality diagnosis through microscopy or rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs). 100% of confirmed malaria cases at the health facilities and community-level receive correct and timely treatment. 80% of malaria epidemics are detected and contained according to the national guidelines (within 15 days). 80% of the planned operational research is completed. 80% of the population adopts the recommended behavior to the fight against malaria according to the national guidelines by 2021. 80% of program management support interventions are delivered
